name: Vision Therapy Vault
tagline: Binocular Vision Disorders and Orthoptic Therapy
description: A 15-episode series on binocular vision and vision therapy — from convergence insufficiency through accommodative and ocular motor dysfunction to amblyopia treatment protocols.

episodes.title: The Binocular Vision Workup: Phorias, Tropias, and the AC/A Ratio
episodes.description: The stepwise binocular vision exam, the cover test at distance and near, the gradient and computed AC/A ratio methods.

episodes.title: Convergence Insufficiency: The CISS-R and the CITT-ART Evidence
episodes.description: The CISS-R symptom score, the NPC and fusional vergence findings, and the office-based vision therapy evidence from CITT-ART.

episodes.title: Accommodative Dysfunction: Insufficiency, Excess, and Infacility
episodes.description: The near point of accommodation, the amplitude relative to age (Hofstetter), and the monocular and binocular facility testing.

episodes.title: Ocular Motor Dysfunction: Saccades, Pursuits, and the NSUCO Assessment
episodes.description: The NSUCO ocular motor test, the developmental eye movement (DEM) test, and the therapy protocols for ocular motor dysfunction.

episodes.title: Sensory Fusion Training: Worth 4 Dot, Stereopsis, and Suppression
episodes.description: The Worth 4 Dot for sensory fusion, the Titmus and Randot stereopsis, and the therapy progression from anti-suppression to fusion.

episodes.title: Stereopsis Development and the Lang, Titmus, and Randot Tests
episodes.description: The local vs global stereopsis distinction, the test selection by age, and the amblyogenic risk when stereopsis is absent.

episodes.title: Amblyopia Therapy: Patching vs Atropine Penalisation and the PEDIG Evidence
episodes.description: The PEDIG dosing (2 hours vs 6 hours of patching), the atropine penalisation alternative, and the age cut-off debate.

episodes.title: Vision Therapy for Intermittent Exotropia: The Basic, Divergence, and Convergence Types
episodes.description: The Burian classification of IXO, the over-minus lens trial, and the vergence therapy protocol and the surgery threshold.

episodes.title: Sports Vision Training: Hand-Eye Coordination and Dynamic Visual Acuity
episodes.description: The sports vision assessment battery, the dynamic visual acuity and contrast sensitivity testing, and the training protocols.

episodes.title: Vision Therapy and Learning Disabilities: What the Evidence Supports
episodes.description: The evidence (and the controversy) for vision therapy in reading difficulty, the dyslexia and Irlen syndrome debate, and the honest parent counselling.

episodes.title: Computer-Based Vision Therapy: HTS, Computer Orthopter, and the Evidence
episodes.description: The home therapy systems (HTS), the office vs home therapy balance, and the evidence for computer-based vergence and accommodation therapy.

episodes.title: Tracking and Saccadic Training: The Readalyzer and the Reading Connection
episodes.description: The Readalyzer assessment of reading eye movements, the DEM test correlation, and the saccadic training protocol.

episodes.title: SILO, Yeats, and the Lens Flippers: The Therapy Toolkit
episodes.description: The SILO (small in, large out) response to lens flippers, the bifocal and base-in/base-out prism flippers, and the sequence of therapy.

episodes.title: Home Therapy Programs: Compliance, Frequency, and the Parent Role
episodes.description: The therapy frequency (2-3 times per week in office, daily at home), the parent compliance strategies, and the progress monitoring.

episodes.title: Outcome Measures in Vision Therapy: When to Discharge and When to Refer
episodes.description: The objective and subjective outcome measures, the discharge criteria, and when to refer for strabismus surgery.
